metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2012 · The Hunger Games
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen voluntarily takes her younger sister's place in the Hunger Games: a televised competition in which two teenagers from each of the twelve Districts of Panem are chosen at random to fight to the death.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2013 · Iron Man 3
metas.description: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2013 · Man of Steel
metas.description: An alien child is evacuated from his dying world and sent to Earth to live among humans. His peace is threatened when other survivors of his home planet invade Earth.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2012 · The Amazing Spider-Man
metas.description: After Peter Parker is bitten by a genetically altered spider, he gains newfound, spider-like powers and ventures out to save the city from the machinations of a mysterious reptilian foe.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2013 · The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the 74th Hunger Games sparks a rebellion in the Districts of Panem.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2012 · Prometheus
metas.description: Following clues to the origin of mankind, a team finds a structure on a distant moon, but they soon realize they are not alone.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2011 · Limitless
metas.description: A mysterious pill that enables the user to access 100% of his brain's abilities transforms a struggling writer into a financial wizard, but it also puts him in a new world with many dangers.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2012 · Looper
metas.description: In 2074, when the mob wants to get rid of someone, the target is sent into the past, where a hired gun awaits - someone like Joe - who one day learns the mob wants to 'close the loop' by sending back Joe's future self for assassin...

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2013 · Oblivion
metas.description: A stranger's arrival triggers one man's battle to save mankind.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2013 · Snowpiercer
metas.description: In a future where a failed climate change experiment has killed all life except for the survivors who boarded the Snowpiercer (a train that travels around the globe), a new class system emerges.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2012 · Cloud Atlas
metas.description: As souls are born and reborn, they renew their connections to one another throughout the ages.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2011 · Real Steel
metas.description: In a near future where robot boxing is a top sport, a struggling ex-boxer feels he's found a champion in a discarded robot.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2011 · Super 8
metas.description: During the summer of 1979, a group of friends witness a train crash and investigate subsequent unexplained events in their small town.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2015 · Predestination
metas.description: As his last assignment, a temporal agent is tasked to travel back in time and prevent a bomb attack in New York in 1975. The hunt, however, turns out to be beyond the bounds of possibility.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2012 · Dredd
metas.description: In a violent, futuristic metropolis, a law enforcement and his rookie trainee become caught up in a high-stakes drug war.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2012 · Chronicle
metas.description: Three high school friends gain superpowers after making an incredible discovery underground. Soon they find their lives spinning out of control and their bond tested as they embrace their darker sides.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2011 · Melancholia
metas.description: Two sisters find their already strained relationship challenged as a mysterious new planet threatens to collide with Earth.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2013 · Coherence
metas.description: Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2011 · Perfect Sense
metas.description: A chef and a scientist fall in love as an epidemic begins to rob people of their sensory perceptions.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2010 · Enthiran
metas.description: A brilliant scientist creates a humanoid robot to protect mankind, but things go awry when human emotions are programmed and inner turmoil causes the robot to switch sides.
